svg.title: Chatbot evaluation
svg.desc: Each of the 32 gold-set questions is asked as a fresh single turn, and four conversations test follow-ups. The run records the answer shown and every tool call with its result, then checks tool selection, advice and scope behaviour, citations, fixed replies and figures no tool returned, in the first draft and in the answer shown. A recheck scores stored answers again without calling a model. An LLM judge orders the answers for a person, who rates each one. Retrieval is scored on its own against people's aspect labels. A usability questionnaire is planned.

Gold set v2: 32 questions
lookup 9, compare 5, out-of-scope 4, advice 4,
trend 3, evidence 3, thin data 2, consensus 2
